name: @storytree/dev-loop
description: Mick's dev loop (story_95ed402f9bd3, ADR-0805 D3, ADR-1170 D3, ADR-1192 D2): the personal half of the dev loop, around the base dev loop (packages/base-dev-loop), which holds the gate runner, the test runner and its scoping, the worktree installer and the merge-queue scripts: storytree's gate (its lock, worktree install and the checks it contributes; the repository's own checks contribute theirs from packages/repo-checks), its `pnpm test` (the base runner holding the heavy-run lock), the guidance build, and the library's export and restore (which reach the library through the repository's own checks' library server). The root package.json's commands and CI run them from here.
